title: SceneAxi held-key registry snapshot (v1)
description: Machine-readable snapshot of captain decision keys, generated from the authoritative FirstMate structured backlog (tasks-axi captain holds, identities <origin>-decision-<key>). The Markdown registry in factories-helpers #42 documents these keys for humans; it is never the runtime source. Consumers MUST fail closed per docs/held-key-enforcement.md.

registryEpoch.description: Monotonic counter incremented whenever a key is added or removed. A CLI built for epoch N MUST refuse held-key-gated commands when the snapshot epoch differs from what its command map was built against.

source.description: Identifier of the authoritative structured backlog the snapshot was exported from (never a Markdown document).

sourceDigest.description: Digest of the canonicalized exported hold set, for integrity checks.

decisionRecord.description: Pointer to the durable captain decision record; required when state is resolved.
